title: Crashes a lot!
body: This app is good when it works but when it doesn’t you have to reload it and wait ages for all your jobs to reload from the cloud. It is a pain!
author: kcmclaren

title: To Do I use weekly if not daily
body:
This app I use on every device.
One of the best apps in my deck.
Very dependable, easy to find and use.
author: Michael MacGinty

title: Almost perfect
body:
Great app. Sharing and collaboration on shopping lists, packing lists etc is fantastic. 

My only gripe is it’s ridiculously difficult to reorder a list by dragging and dropping on your phone.

title: Closing randomly and freezing
body: Since the last update the app has been unusable on IPhone. It freezes after a few seconds of use and shuts down . Please fix.
author: KM7900

title: Half baked
body: Tasks keep disappearing/not saving, doesn’t sync tasks across multiple MS accounts, doesn’t show future tasks on the Widget. Really just frustrating and not fit for purpose.
author: acrose in SA

title: Searching within lists
body: The list search is poor. I would like to be able to search for an item on my lists easier . I have a large amount of items on one particular list and I have a number of medium lists, scrolling up and Down takes too long and using search for all lists is also time consuming. It would be great to search easily within each category/list
author: M1r2gr3

title: Cumbersome to use
body: No search function to find repeat entries
author: MinaBuy

title: Behind The Competition
body: Good app but not having location based reminders or interactive widgets when Reminders, Todoist, and others have for years is really poor
author: James F Collins

title: So close to perfect
body: I use this app constantly which makes its weird little failings really frustrating. The biggest one for me is the entire app relaunches if I navigate somewhere else. Which means when I’m paging between a recipe and the app I have to wait for it to reload back up every time. This feels like an easy fix, and I hope they get to it in a future bug fix! Otherwise it’s pretty great, I use it for everything
author: bsangster90

title: Microsoft To Do
body: Amazing!!
author: finn dev

title: It’s “ok” , nothing more
body:
It does the basics but issues go unfixed for years and there does not appear to be investment. 
The iOS version is a bit buggy if you use it a lot (perhaps ok for the casual user)
After all these years still miss wunderlist :-(
author: Paddlepop

title: Great app that helps me through the day.
body: I am glad I found this app, it is very useful in planning the week, month and a year. Thanks for your service, brilliant!

title: Feedback
body:
Some ideas, could be

Why doesn’t ‘important’ appear on the outlook online ?

title: Multi account.
body: Needs the functionality to swap Microsoft accounts without having to sign out of the first account and into a second. Come on Microsoft. 3 stars at best until this happens. Then it’s an easy 4/5

title: It is a great app for planning tasks digitally.
body: Thanks for providing the app that makes my day productive.
author: danitsip

title: Grt but please add more
body:
Amazing app love the My Day feature.

However, please add
Ability to drag tasks between lists
Include a taskboard for personal users since planner does not support it 
Add widgets of all sizes and make colours and tasks on them customizable

title: Allocate time.
body: If would be nice one could allocate time to complete each task

title: Crashes on iOS 16 when trying to set date
body:
Seems like a nice app. Easy to add things to do. Then try to set a date on a new todo, and the app freezes when swiping the calendar for a custom date, then crashes. 

No widget support either based on the lack of widget showing in the widget selector for the customisable Home Screen.

title: Not good
body: Why completely rebuilt an app?! Wunderlist was very good and worked perfectly. Already having account login issues. Reset password. Still can’t login. Done. Deleting this app
author: sfoconnell

title: Not very smart and user friendly
body:
The app keeps logging me off without notifying me, then I miss my reminders when I’m not logged in.
Creating reminders is not smart, for example when I type “Tuesday “, the reminder still creates with today’s due date.
author: tompaulman

title: Why take a perfect product and replace it with this?
body: You took over Wunderlist which was the best to do app in the market and started rebuilding a new app from scratch. Now you’ll be discontinuing a perfectly good app (Wunderlist) to replace it with this buggy, incomplete app? A simple rebrand and further improvement would have been so much better. I’ll be looking for an alternative until To Do is up to the same level as Wunderlist.

title: Dreadful
body: Not a patch on wunderlist.

title: Unbelievably Awful
body: This terrible app swallowed a really brilliant one called Wundelist. Avoid it if at all possible!
